name: todo-app-workspace
description: Scalable React and Express todo app workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace app/server" "npm run dev --workspace app/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace app/server && npm run build --workspace app/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace app/server && npm run test --workspace app/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace app/server && npm run lint --workspace app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace app/server && npm run typecheck --workspace app/client
